But don’t take our word for it…
Our awesome people speak!

Eitan "Batzeki" Lazarovski

R&D Team Leader

It was spring 2010 when I got ‘the call’ from my friend – “A great company is looking for software engineers!” Nine years later (but who’s counting?) we’re still working together at Atera!

Atera was my first R&D job, and since then I’ve come a long way. I started out as a junior developer, and now, I’m a team Leader—leading other developers, testers and designers.

The experience of building an entire product from scratch is truly remarkable and could be called a ‘once-in-a-lifetime’ opportunity for many developers. Fortunately for me, Atera put their trust in me as a young developer, and over the years we’ve built the most amazing and revolutionary, all-in-one platform for companies around the world.

At Atera, new employees are embraced and given chances to make a difference, to contribute, and evolve both personally and professionally. Working in this kind of caring environment, it feels truly like a family of sorts, and makes all the difference in your day-to-day feelings of job satisfaction.

Liron Hanania

DevOps

After 3 years working in technical support for two Telcom companies, I was ready to make the leap to a global company with a wide range of applications.

My best friend (now Atera's CTO) called me and offered me a job as a support engineer. I couldn't wait to start. Working with your best friend is a gift! Two weeks after I joined, I invited another colleague to come in for an interview at Atera, and now he holds the position of dev team leader.

I began my Atera journey in technical support, tackling networking problems and complex IT and system issues. Now, nine years later, with an extensive technical background and years of managerial challenges, I'm now in the role of DevOps.

This is a technically challenging and interesting position, dealing with infrastructure stability. While my developer teammates may finally fix a bug at 2 am, I stay awake, until I’ve made sure everything is fully back to operational for the customer.
